Queen of Hearts

By: Siniketiwe Hlanze | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Queen of hearts, what will it take to charm the country’s first ever Bachelorette.

Unique Selling Point:
Qiniso Van Damme, a beauty with brains and heart will soon be South Africa’s most sought after single lady. A first for The Bachelor franchise in the country, after two consecutive seasons of women trying to catch the attention of a heartthrob bachelor the roles are changing. This time it’ll be the guys vying to capture the heart of this Cape Town born beauty.

Summary:
A crop of the country’s most impressive young men will be putting their best foot forward for a chance at love with the country’s first Bachelorette, Qiniso Van Damme. A show known for steamy jacuzzi conversations and intimate stolen kisses, we go behind the scenes to see if romance can still blossom within the limitations of an infectious virus. A sit down interview with the Bachelorette herself and director Delarey Hattingh.

Script:


VO UPSOUND
After two successful seasons of the Bachelor, it’s only fitting that the next instalment of this much loved show would be the Bachelorette
07:28 Q- So I definitely think I’m single right now in my life because I’ve focused so heavily on my career and being independent.

09:50 here I am I’m smart and quirky and I happen to be gorgeous hahahaaha.
Cape Town born Qiniso Van Damme is officially South Africa’s most eligible Bachelorette, a model and actress, the vibrant 26 year old is currently enrolled for a Masters Degree in Anthropology at UCT.

A powerhouse in the making, Van Damme says her drive is inspired by strong black women.

03:04 So Michelle Obama is definitely one of my dream queens, my mother she has two degrees, two masters, she got her PHD at age 54 she embodies for me the kind of woman that is like No isn’t an option. Then there’s my sister, my sister is one of the most fierce women of colour in her party. In parliament she puts forward women’s rights, the youth and just in general issues that we face today,

3:52 Mac- You must have a close relationship with your sister, do the debates get heated, I mean what do you guys talk about
04:03 Q- so we have a general rule okay, family gatherings we don’t talk politics04:15 So we have a general rule, we don’t talk politics at family gatherings. But of course it always comes forward but my sister, people don’t know this about my sister. My sister is the most goofy human being alive. Like her and I shoot beyonce videos in our PJs and we love sci-fi we’re super nerds, all the Star-trek, all the star wars and uhm we just love doing make up things together too, that’s my best friend.


(Part2)
00:00 Mac – Qiniso there’s a lot of doom in the world right now and a lot of uncertainty and you decided this is the perfect time to find love
00:19 Q – I mean I feel like finding love makes sense in any situation. Especially in a doom and gloom time, you need to foster love and focus on love cause you guys kunzima with this whole epidemic. Uhm it will be nice to have a bae to in quarantine with yabona, not just my
(Part2)
03:03 Mac- so In the previous season you had quite a rapport and quite a nice thing going with marc, but you didn’t make it till the end. Why did you decide to come back.
03:47 I’m here again because I definitely believe in this process, Maricia and Marc look so happy and I need this that kind of piece too and nothing else has been working,Mnet is gonna have my back, they’re gonna find me the crem dela crem, they’re gonna line them up and I’m gonna have my pick. So I very much believe in this process, excited and a bit scared.
(Part)
00:42 Mac – What would be you farytale ending to this…. When you walk off into the sunset what does that look like for you
00:57 Q – It looks like cows for my family, because if azikho, ayikho. My ending, my walking off into the sunset is having my traditional wedding 10:15 Ive dated across the spectrum racially. So my family is always ready to learn when I bring someone home
and having my beautiful creative conceptual wedding, think sollange. 1:30 I definitely want to stay true to my cultural heritage and I know it would make my grandfather happy to see those cows coming
